rationale: The core workflow involves sharing group codes with other riders. Currently users must verbally communicate the code or manually type it elsewhere. A tap-to-copy with visual feedback and a share button would significantly improve this critical user flow.
problemSolved: In GroupInfoCard, the group code is displayed in a Surface badge with primaryContainer color. There's a 'Share code XXXX-XX to let others join' text hint with share icon, but clicking does nothing. No clipboard or Android Share sheet integration.
